prompt: Name TWO measures of **center** for a data set (separate with a comma).
hint: A measure of center is a single number that answers "what is a typical value in this data?"

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Mean is fair-shares; median is the middle. Pick the one the question actually asks for.
A measure of center is a single number that answers "what is a typical value in this data?"
There are three common ones: the fair-share average, the middle value of the sorted list, and the most frequent value. Name any two of them.
Two measures of center are the mean and the median (the mode would also count).

explanation: A measure of center describes a typical value of a data set with one number.
The mean is the fair-share average, the median is the middle value in order, and the mode is the most common value.
Any two of these work, so one correct answer is mean, median.
